Phase 1 / Step 0 orientation
- Step 0(a): tracker sweep for "tickets branch size", "tickets-store growth", "repository size", "reconciler growth", and open/in-progress bugs found closed epic censual-organic-mouflon (0303-692c-55dc-4a18), which claimed a fresh clone <=150 MB after reclaim. This report is treated as a regression and linked duplicates; the prior diagnosis is evidence, not an assumed cause.
- Step 0(b): no version was quoted; ticket created_at 1787506178295653001 gives reported-on-or-after floor ce496143fe1f72a07efeb0173da37013262ec446. No commits exist from that floor to origin/main in src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler or src/rebar/_store.
- Step 0(c): fresh debug worktree HEAD ce496143fe1f72a07efeb0173da37013262ec446 exactly equals origin/main.
Triage: full protocol. Multiple live alternatives remain (remote reachable history, local unreachable pre-rewrite objects/reflogs, ref pins, renewed reconciler churn, high commit/tree volume, or another path), so the fast path is not justified.
